businessGoal: Enable users to filter items by category efficiently.

scenarios.goal: User successfully filters items by selecting a specific category.
User attempts to filter items but selects an invalid category.
Check that the filtering results update correctly when a new category is selected.

clarifications: No specifications on default filter settings or behavior when no items match the selected category.

manual.reason: The story involves user interactions with filter options, which require manual testing.

api.reason: The story does not specify any backend API behavior related to filtering.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria will likely involve visible UI changes related to filtering items.
